The upstream files are unmodified. Only the core library sources, public and
internal headers, license, copyright, changelog and introduction are vendored.
CMakeLists.txt and this file are local integration files. LMDB is compiled as
a static C library and linked privately into LocalDatabase. No network access
is needed to configure or build it.
